summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend-only. Executed the four remaining tests requested and produced concrete results (no code-review fallbacks). (A) Theme matrix across 16 routes x 2 modes (32 combos) — every route rendered with html.className tracking theme correctly, zero pageerrors, sampled fg/bg contrast >=15 on visible copy in both light and dark. Admin product-dialog, event-dialog, orders-status Radix dropdown, and populated cart drawer verified in BOTH themes with computed color pairs and WCAG contrast ratios (all >=4.5). (B) Push lifecycle MOCKED at Notification / PushManager / serviceWorker layer (labelled MOCKED). Notification.requestPermission call-count = 0 on mount and 1 after each explicit Activer click; permission=default keeps state 'non activées'; permission=denied flips to 'refusées' with denied-help + disabled Activer; permission=granted with a VALID browser-generated P-256 subscription -> real POST /admin/push/subscriptions returns 200, state becomes 'activées', Test+Désactiver appear, reload keeps 'activées' (backend registered=true) with rp_calls=0 & subscribe=0; MOCKED /admin/push/test intercept returns 200 and UI info banner shown; Désactiver calls unsubscribe+DELETE, state returns to 'non activées', reload confirms. (C) Service Worker /public/sw.js loaded UNMODIFIED into a Node VM harness (MOCKED self/registration/clients): push event with payload -> showNotification called once with correct title/body/tag/data.url; push event with empty payload -> defaults; notificationclick with existing same-origin window -> client.navigate + focus, no openWindow; no window -> openWindow with query preserved; foreign origin or non-/admin/commandes pathname -> ignored. 6/6 SW cases pass. (D) Chat: customer polling picked up admin reply within 5s tick without reload; with document.hidden overridden to true (labelled browser visibility MOCKED) admin sent a new message and NO POST /chat/conversations/{id}/read fired during 7.5s; on restoring visible exactly 1 /read call fired. All backend calls hit the real preview API; only Notification/PushManager/SW APIs and the /admin/push/test response were browser-side mocked. Real OS push delivery remains a manual step.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminPush.js correctly gates Notification.requestPermission behind the explicit user click (enable()), never in useEffect — verified with rp_calls==0 on mount across two full page loads.
sw.js notificationclick has a strict same-origin + pathname==/admin/commandes guard — safe against forged url payloads (verified in harness).
sw.js uses client.navigate to preserve deep-link query (?order=<id>) into the existing SPA window — pairs correctly with iteration 4's ProtectedRoute pathname+search+hash fix.
ChatThread.markRead correctly guards on document.hidden and filters own-role messages — verified in-browser (0 /read calls while hidden, 1 after visible).

Backend correctly rejects invalid Web-Push P-256 keys with 422 'Clé Push invalide.' — confirmed manually; our first mock without valid crypto was rightly refused, then a browser-generated SubtleCrypto P-256 key passed end-to-end.
Radix Select options inside admin orders filter render with lower contrast (6.34 light / 7.44 dark) than page body copy — still WCAG AA large-text pass; no action needed.

mocked_scope_declaration: PRODUCTION features touched: NONE. BROWSER-TEST mocks (labelled): (a) Notification.requestPermission / Notification.permission, (b) window.PushManager stub, (c) navigator.serviceWorker.register/ready with an in-memory registration whose pushManager.subscribe generates a REAL P-256 key via SubtleCrypto so the real backend accepts the subscription, (d) context.route intercept of /admin/push/test to return 200, (e) document.hidden / visibilityState getters + synthetic visibilitychange event, (f) Node VM harness with mocked self/registration/clients that loads the UNMODIFIED /public/sw.js. Every other network call was real (login, /admin/push/config, /admin/push/status, POST+DELETE /admin/push/subscriptions, /chat/conversations/**/messages, /chat/conversations/**/read). Real OS-level push delivery via FCM/APNs is out of scope for headless testing and remains a manual step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 closed all frontend gaps requested. sw_test.js can be re-run any time via `cd /app/frontend && node sw_test.js`. The Playwright mocks used context.add_init_script (executed before app JS) which is the only reliable way to intercept Notification and navigator.serviceWorker. If backend push crypto changes, regenerate the SubtleCrypto P-256 key in the mock — do NOT hardcode a fake p256dh (backend rejects with 422).
